fire: In the north, peat was once widely used for heating cottages.
A spreadsheet like this can be used for tracking monthly expenses.
The cellar under the chapel is used for storing wine.
Bamboo poles can be used for building light scaffolding.
These small brushes are used for cleaning the engine parts.
The meadow behind the school may be used for football practice.
Old newspapers can be used for wrapping fragile glasses.
The larger kiln was used for firing roof tiles.
